units.source_text: 他把这首诗系在一枝被风吹折的苓草上。

en.t: He tied this poem to a sprig of ling grass that had been broken by the wind.

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“交野少将的情书是系在和信纸同样颜色的花枝上的。

en.t: The ladies in waiting said, "Major Katano's love letters were tied to flowering branches of the same color as the writing paper.

units.source_text: 你的信纸是紫色的，怎么系在绿色的苓草上呢？”

en.t: Your writing paper is purple, so why have you tied it to green ling grass?"

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“色彩配合等事，我是不懂得的呀。

en.t: Yugiri answered, "I know nothing about matching colors and such things.

units.source_text: 那么，教我选用哪处田野里的花呢？”

en.t: Then please tell me which field's flowers I should choose."

units.source_text: 他对这些侍女不多说话，亦无放任不拘的举止，

en.t: He did not speak much with these ladies in waiting, nor did he behave in any careless or unrestrained way,

units.source_text: 真是个循规蹈矩的高尚人物。

en.t: and he was truly a noble person who observed proper conduct.

units.source_text: 夕雾又写了一封信，一起交付一个叫作右马助的侍女。

en.t: Yugiri wrote another letter and handed them together to a lady in waiting called Uma no Suke.

units.source_text: 右马助对一个美貌的女童和一个亲近的随从悄悄地说了几句话，便把信交付他们。

en.t: Uma no Suke quietly said a few words to a beautiful young girl and a close attendant, then handed the letters to them.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女看到这光景，大家猜疑起来，不知道这信是写给谁的。

en.t: When the young ladies in waiting saw this, they all began to wonder suspiciously, not knowing whom the letter was meant for.
